India Withdraws from ASEAN Cup for Brazil Friendly Match

The Indian national football team has withdrawn from the ASEAN Cup, scheduled for October. This decision was made to prioritize a friendly match against Brazil. The withdrawal allows the team to focus on preparation for the Brazil fixture.
